heading.en: Setting money aside, for two different reasons

hook.en: A shopkeeper knows some customers will never pay, and also wants to save for a new shop. The first is a provision; the second is a reserve.
hook.kn: ಕೆಲವು ಗ್ರಾಹಕರು ಹಣ ಕೊಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಅಂಗಡಿಯವನಿಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತು; ಹೊಸ ಅಂಗಡಿಗೂ ಉಳಿಸಬೇಕು. ಮೊದಲನೆಯದು ಅವಕಾಶ, ಎರಡನೆಯದು ಮೀಸಲು ನಿಧಿ.

objectives.en: Distinguish between a provision and a reserve.
Classify reserves as revenue and capital reserves.
Explain secret reserves and reserve funds.

narration.en: A shopkeeper knows some customers will never pay, and also wants to save for a new shop. The first is a provision; the second is a reserve.
narration.kn: ಕೆಲವು ಗ್ರಾಹಕರು ಹಣ ಕೊಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಅಂಗಡಿಯವನಿಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತು; ಹೊಸ ಅಂಗಡಿಗೂ ಉಳಿಸಬೇಕು. ಮೊದಲನೆಯದು ಅವಕಾಶ, ಎರಡನೆಯದು ಮೀಸಲು ನಿಧಿ.

body.en: A provision is an amount charged against profit to provide for a known liability or an expected loss whose amount cannot be determined with certainty. Examples: provision for depreciation, for bad and doubtful debts, for taxation, for repairs and renewals. A provision must be made whether the business earns a profit or not.

points.en: For a known liability or expected loss
Made even when there is a loss

Examples: provision for depreciation, for bad and doubtful debts, for taxation, for repairs and renewals. A provision must be made whether the business earns a profit or not.
narration.kn: ಅವಕಾಶ ಎಂದರೆ ಗೊತ್ತಿರುವ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಅಥವಾ ನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿತ ನಷ್ಟಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಲಾಭದಿಂದ ವಿಧಿಸುವ ಮೊತ್ತ. ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗೆ ಸಂದೇಹಾಸ್ಪದ ಸಾಲ, ತೆರಿಗೆ, ಸವಕಳಿಗೆ ಅವಕಾಶ. ಲಾಭ ಇರಲಿ ಇಲ್ಲದಿರಲಿ ಅವಕಾಶ ಮಾಡಲೇಬೇಕು.

body.en: A reserve is an appropriation of profit retained in the business to strengthen its financial position or meet unknown future needs. Revenue reserves come from operating profit: general reserve, and specific reserves such as dividend equalisation reserve. Capital reserves come from capital profits: premium on issue of shares, profit on sale of fixed assets, profit on revaluation. A secret reserve is not shown in the balance sheet; a reserve fund is a reserve invested outside the business.

narration.kn: ಮೀಸಲು ನಿಧಿ ಎಂದರೆ ವ್ಯವಹಾರವನ್ನು ಬಲಪಡಿಸಲು ಲಾಭದಿಂದ ಮಾಡುವ ವಿನಿಯೋಗ. ಆದಾಯ ಮೀಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮೀಸಲು ಎಂಬ ವಿಧಗಳಿವೆ. ಗುಪ್ತ ಮೀಸಲು ಆಢಾವೆ ಪತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಣಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

problem.en: Kamadhenu Dairy earns a profit of ₹5,00,000 before provisions. It provides ₹20,000 for doubtful debts and ₹1,20,000 for income tax, and then transfers 10% of the net profit to general reserve. Find the amount of the general reserve and the profit left.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Kamadhenu Dairy earns a profit of ₹5,00,000 before provisions. It provides ₹20,000 for doubtful debts and ₹1,20,000 for income tax, and then transfers 10% of the net profit to general reserve. Find the amount of the general reserve and the profit left.

heading.en: Provision before profit, reserve after profit

body.en: If it is deducted to FIND the net profit, it is a provision (a charge). If it is set aside OUT OF the net profit, it is a reserve (an appropriation).

narration.en: Provision before profit, reserve after profit. If it is deducted to FIND the net profit, it is a provision (a charge). If it is set aside OUT OF the net profit, it is a reserve (an appropriation).

mnemonic.en: Provision: before the line. Reserve: below the line.
